declared_unsupported_operations.reason: WebSocket upload transfer protocol is not implemented by this HTTP domain. HTTP upload transfer is deprecated; only tracking endpoints are implemented.
GET RRD parameter placement (body versus query) is not documented; POST is implemented.
VM update request body and partial update semantics are unspecified. Reading, creation, deletion and explicit state actions are implemented.
VM console uses a QEMU WebSocket protocol, outside this typed HTTP domain.
VM VNC uses a QEMU WebSocket protocol, outside this typed HTTP domain.
Disk create task-id JSON result shape is unspecified; no invented int or {id} response contract.
Disk resize task-id JSON result shape is unspecified; no invented int or {id} response contract.
LteRadio.bands has no documented element type; the only example is empty. No guessed DTO is emitted.
MLO PUT formal signature targets wifi/config/ but section and example target BSS MLO config. No competing overload is emitted until route is established.
The fmt=json result schema is not documented. fmt=plain is implemented as a binary download.

OpenVPN client configuration/import schema absent; typed creation of type=openvpn is rejected locally. PPTP/WireGuard creation, existing configuration read/update/delete and activation flags are implemented.
Concrete /profile/3 signature conflicts with collection example; no canonical generic update route established.
Result shape absent; neither an array nor a keyed map is established.
Literal network_controlr path and request/result schemas unresolved; no mutation fallback.
Operation body binding and result not defined; read model is not used as a guessed write DTO.
No specialized QEMU text/character-console client; generic handshake alone does not assert JSON console semantics.
No specialized VNC binary client. JSON event/upload receive API does not represent a VNC stream.
